summary: Iteration 8 testing complete: Self-Heal meta description fixes (>160 chars detection + GPT-4o regeneration) and Content Enrichment (2 pages/batch to avoid timeout) both working correctly. All 9 backend tests passed. All frontend UI components verified with inline status banners visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Self-Heal (POST /api/seo-audit/auto-fix) now scans CMS pages directly for meta descriptions <80 or >160 chars - fixes applied with action='shortened'
Auto-fix response includes 'total_needing_fix' field showing how many pages still need fixes
Content enrichment batch size reduced to max_pages=2 (from 5) to avoid 60s proxy timeout - successfully completes within time limit
Inline status banners display correctly with data-testid='seo-status-message' and data-testid='enrich-status-message'
Status messages visible immediately below buttons (no scrolling required)
Default meta description in SEO.jsx shortened from 213 to ~140 chars
context_for_next_testing_agent: Self-Heal is now working correctly - it found and fixed 2 pages with meta descriptions >160 chars in the first run. Subsequent runs may show 'All pages already have meta data' if no more pages need fixing. Content enrichment with max_pages=2 completes successfully. Avg completeness improved from 78%->81% after enrichment runs. 32 pages still need enrichment.

POST /api/seo-audit/auto-fix.details: Fixed 2 pages with long meta descriptions (163 and 167 chars). Returns {success:true, fixes_applied:2, total_needing_fix:2, fixes:[{type, slug, value, status:'applied', action:'shortened', old_length, new_length}]}

POST /api/content-enrich (max_pages=2).details: Enriched 2/2 pages successfully without timeout. Returns {success:true, enriched:2, total_attempted:2, results:[{slug, enriched:true, sections_added:[...], type}]}

GET /api/content-gaps (regression).details: Returns 59 total pages, 81% avg completeness, 32 need enrichment

GET /api/seo-audit/history (regression).details: Returns audit history for trend chart

GET /api/seo-audit/fixes.details: Returns fix history with latest fix record
